fact: Startup Arcube announced a USD 1.5 million (TND 4.7 million) funding round co-led by Tunis-based fund 216 CAPITAL with Fuel Ventures and Oxford Capital Partners.
The round was co-led by 216 CAPITAL, described as an investment fund based in Tunis and founded there in 2021, so a Tunisian financier is named in the USD 1.5 million round.
The Franco-Tunisian startup Thunder Code finalised a USD 9 million seed round led by Silicon Badia with Janngo, Titan Seed Fund and MEDIN Fund Management, as reported by Managers.
AfriqueITNews reports that Tunisian fintech Konnect Networks recently raised USD 1.5 million from investors including Attijariwafa Ventures, Visa and Plug and Play Tech Center.

IRBE7, citing Attijari Bank's first-quarter 2025 report, says a bank consortium led by Attijari granted Ooredoo a TND 310 million syndicated loan that let it acquire its 5G licence in December 2024 and deploy its national 5G network.
IRBE7 reports the TND 310 million syndicated loan to Ooredoo for 5G was led by Attijari Bank Tunisie, as lead of a bank consortium.
